items.source: Uses of DirtiesContext.MethodMode in org.springframework.test.annotation
Uses of DirtiesContext.MethodMode in org.springframework.test.context.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.test.context.support` 中 `DirtiesContext.MethodMode` 的用法

items.source: Perform the actual work for AbstractTestExecutionListener.beforeTestMethod(TestContext) and AbstractTestExecutionListener.afterTestMethod(TestContext) by dirtying the context if appropriate (i.e., according to the required modes).
items.translation: 执行 AbstractTestExecutionListener.beforeTestMethod(TestContext) 和 AbstractTestExecutionListener.afterTestMethod(TestContext)，并在适当的情况下弄脏上下文（即根据所需的模式）。

items.source: Defines modes which determine how @DirtiesContext is interpreted when used to annotate a test method.
items.translation: 定义modes，用于确定在用作测试方法的注解时如何解释@DirtiesContext。

items.source: Support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.

items.translation: 支持注解驱动测试的支持类。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。
